schema_version: 1
table: tz_authoring_job
natural_key: idempotency_key
request_identity: normalized request SHA-256 including v2 orchestration intent; v1 encoding remains unchanged
states: [PLANNED, GENERATING, VERIFYING, READY, STAGED, FAILED]
concurrency: expiring renewable lease with fencing token
maximum_attempts: 5
artifact: normalized private authoring candidate plus exact content-addressed verification receipt
technical_task:
  source: artifact_json.Candidate.Blueprint
  read_model: deterministic technical-task.v1 projection
  duplicate_column: not_used_in_v1
  migration_required: false
  backward_compatibility: existing READY rows retain their artifact; the legacy publication_json column and any recorded values are not rewritten, and rows with a legacy receipt fail closed pending explicit reconciliation
staging: nullable validated Practice-owned private staging receipt; successful persistence transitions the TZ job from READY to STAGED
staging_payload: complete blueprint, private evaluation bundle, verification receipt, and provenance remain in Practice private staging
public_projection_excludes: [request, private fixtures, code_structure, provider input, raw provider output]
terminal_replay: READY and STAGED claim fallback returns the committed job unchanged before the attempt cap; terminal rows receive no claim or lease mutation.
terminal_replay_scope: Exact normalized request identity remains required; STAGED replay performs no authoring or staging work and does not create a public revision.
